content.short: DashX helps Indian freelancers and businesses get paid by international clients via stablecoins.
content.description: DashX lets people in India receive payments from international clients in 25+ currencies and stablecoins and get them straight into an Indian bank account, with compliance documents for accountants. Stable's official ecosystem page lists DashX.
content.meta: DashX lets Indians get paid internationally via stablecoins into local bank accounts, listed on Stable.
